A SELLABLE + no-active + full-6 context still PASSes (nothing loosened). LEG 2 (B1/B4) -- migrations/README (currently STALE, listing only 0001-0005) is updated to list 0001-0016 + a 0017_enforcement note (renumbered from the taken 0014; 0014-0016 are M6.2Q ads_spend; authored at server-bind, NO SQL written). NO migration SQL, NO config change, NO wiring, NO new secret, NO flag flip, NO PASS branch. ADVERSARIAL RED-TEAM (ultracode, 2 finder dimensions + skeptics): the legs-2/3+spec finder returned 2 findings (both actionable, both fixed) + confirmed legs 2/3 faithful + in-scope + the _risk veto stricter-only; the gate-mapper-vs-suite finder (which prototypes the full leg-1 + reconciliations against the real 729-test suite) stalled for ~85 min without a result and was stopped (its purpose -- the complete carried-break list -- is covered by the corrected reconciliation rules + confirmed by M6-P2902 running the real suite). THE MAJOR (CONFIRMED-by-logic, FIXED): an earlier draft edited recall_risk_contribution to propagate not_sellable -- but that helper's return branches key ONLY on RISK_LOCKS, so a not_sellable-only merged map falls to `return {}` (HOLD, NOT the required FAIL -- contradicting M6-OD-020(b)/SMK-033(iii)), and a complete clean read would return a 7-key map breaking `set(full.keys()) == RISK_LOCKS`. FIX: DROP the propagation entirely -- it is UNNECESSARY (the mapper is UNWIRED; the veto reaches _risk via read.risk_flags fed DIRECTLY, as SMK-030 / the regression do); leaving recall_risk_contribution byte-identical (it copies only the 3 RECALL_RISK_KEYS, never not_sellable) keeps the carried collapse (`bare == {}`) + full-6-key-set tests GREEN with no reconciliation (verified by logic). THE MINOR (FIXED): the reconciliation enumeration was incomplete (omitted test_recall_hold_maps_to_recall, test_value_object_nonbool_presence_flag_is_failclosed). FIX: replaced the enumeration with two MECHANICAL reconciliation RULES -- RULE A (add decision='SELLABLE' to isolate any exact-3-key recall test; not_sellable NOT added) + RULE B (an incomplete/pull-error/malformed test's `risk_flags == {}` / `_risk == HOLD` becomes `{'not_sellable': True}` / FAIL, a strengthening not a nerf) -- plus a rename/reframe of the 'never reads decision' tests to 'never DERIVES the recall booleans from decision', with M6-P2902 running the real suite to confirm the complete list. The plan does NOT claim 'no test breaks' (learning from M6.2T). SCOPE: 3 legs. Out of scope = WIRING the mapper (S1b seam), the C7 session-window design (cross-team Owner/M7), writing the 0017 enforcement SQL, opening the Scale-Gate PASS path (M6-OD-002/005), flag flips. Boundary intact: leg 1 only makes the gate FAIL more (no PASS branch, no scale, RULE-010/FAIL-006); mapper UNWIRED; reading decision is for M6's OWN sellability gate, not owning the recall decision or M3 gating (RULE-018); no CRM/egress/commission. No migration SQL (0001-0016 unchanged). M6-P1000/M6-P1309 stay BLOCKED. Forward: M6-OD-002/005 OPEN (leg 1 armed-not-fired, opens no PASS branch); M6-OD-003/012 OPEN; the S1b wiring seam + live M3 endpoint + the 0017 enforcement SQL + M6-OD-011 server-bind/go-live remain hard gates before any live wiring / real scale / egress. No self-certification; the runner gate + JUDGE (M6-P2909) decide.
